papers.paperTitle: General Studies, Mental Ability and Statistics
papers.paperTitleMr: सामान्य अध्ययन, बुद्धीमापन चाचणी आणि सांख्यिकी

topics: History of India with special reference to Maharashtra
Geography of India with special reference to Maharashtra
Indian Constitution, State Government and Local Government (Rural and Urban) structure, powers and functions
Indian Economy
General Science
National and International Current Affairs
Logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, and analytical ability tests to measure how quickly and accurately a candidate can think
Data Collection: Type of data, Quantitative and Qualitative data, Data for univariate and multivariate cases, Sources of data collection - Primary and Secondary Sources

Presentation of Data: Preparation of frequency tables - Univariate, Bivariate and Multivariate. Diagrammatic and Graphical presentation of data and its interpretation (Histogram, Ogives, Frequency Curve)
Elementary Statistical Methods: Measures of Central tendency - Arithmetic Mean, Geometric Mean, Harmonic Mean, Median, Mode, Quartiles, Deciles, Percentiles
Measures of Dispersion: Absolute and Relative measures - Range, Quartile Deviation, Variance, Standard Deviation and Coefficient of variation
Concepts of Skewness and Kurtosis
Correlation and Regression
Probability: Concept of probability, Elementary laws of probability, Conditional probability, Bayes Theorem, Theory of Expectations
Theoretical Probability Distributions: Binomial, Poisson and Normal

Theory of Statistical Inference: Theory of Estimation - Point Estimation and Interval Estimation - Concept of an Estimator, Desirable properties of an estimator, Methods of Estimation - Ordinary Least square method, Maximum Likelihood Method, Statement of Gauss Markov Theorem
Hypothesis Testing: Simple and composite Hypothesis, Technique of testing of Hypothesis, Small and Large sample tests - t, Normal, Z and F tests contingency Tables
Interpretation of Linear Models: Models with one and more explanatory variables, Significance of regression coefficients, Goodness of fit
Sampling Methods: Simple Random Sampling, Stratified Random Sampling, Systematic Sampling, Cluster Sampling, Multistage Sampling, use of auxiliary information
Index Numbers and Time Series: Index Numbers - Types of Index Numbers - Price, Quantity and Cost of living, Methods of construction of Index Numbers
Time Series Analysis: Components of a time series - Trend, Seasonal variation, Cyclical variation, random variation, Fitting of trend - Moving Average method, Least square method

Statistical Organizations in India: Central Statistical Organization, National Sample Survey Organization, State Directorate of Economics and Statistics, The Reserve Bank of India, Registrar General of India, Types of data collected by them
Vital Statistics in India: Different Birth Rates and death rates, Gross and Net reproduction rates, Infant Mortality rate, Life tables
National Income Estimation: Methods of National Income estimation concepts - Gross Domestic Product, Net Domestic Product, Gross National Product and Net National Product

importantNotes: Latest and recent developments in the above topics will also be expected from candidates.
